title: HtmlTd
responsibility: Renders the native td element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTd.attributes
inputs.description: Native td attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTd.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native td element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTd
outputs.description: The actual native td element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
